info.title: Sentori
info.summary: Self-hosted crash and error reporting for mobile apps.
info.description: Its own wire protocol — not Sentry-compatible, and there is no DSN. Generated from the router by scripts/gen-openapi.mjs; the path list cannot drift from the server.

bearer.description: A token from Settings ▸ Tokens: `st_` plus 26 characters. Scope `ingest` writes; scope `api` reads.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339. No alias — `timestamp` is dropped as unknown and the request then fails as a missing field.

platform.description: A value outside this list is stored as `unknown` rather than refused, so an SDK newer than its server still delivers.

id.description: Optional; supply one only to deduplicate your own retries.

payload.description: Everything else about the event — error, device, app, and any data you attach.

issueId.description: The machine-readable receipt: assert on this rather than opening the dashboard.

post.summary: Register the probes a static scan found
post.description: Every `sentori.probe(ref)` in the source at release time, so a silent probe is visibly alive rather than indistinguishable from deleted code. Needs an `api`-scope token. Duplicates within one call are collapsed and reported.

post.summary: Create, update, delete or run a browser check
post.description: API token. Retry the same commandId with the identical request. Updates/deletes require expectedVersion. Scheduled execution and alerts default off; manual runs require a configured runner. Two queued/running jobs per project.

post.summary: Does this body parse? No token required.
post.description: Parses exactly what ingest parses and answers whether it would have been accepted. Touches no database, names no project, stores nothing, and says nothing about whether a token would work. Rate-limited per IP.

200.description: Parses. `parsed` echoes what was understood, so a field silently dropped as unknown is visible.

400.description: Does not parse. `field` names the offending key where serde identified one.

post.summary: Queue one push using the legacy Insight request format
post.description: Compatibility route. Requires an api-scope project token. Accepts a bare device UUID or its historical ipt_ spelling; returns per-device delivery tickets. New integrations should use /v1/push/sends.

to.description: One device UUID, optionally prefixed with ipt_.

202.description: Queued, not delivered. A deduplicated retry returns no new tickets.

id.description: Delivery ID, not a batch sendId.

400.description: Malformed, missing, revoked or foreign-project device address.

401.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, or wrong-scope token. `hint` names which.

403.description: An api-scope project token is required.

422.description: Invalid request shape or unsupported legacy options. Plain-text body.

500.description: Queue persistence failed; no success ticket is returned.

post.summary: Ingest sampled Web App visits and metric revisions
post.description: Requires ingest scope and an existing webapp identifier. Include healthy visits. Increasing revisions replace metrics without adding a denominator. Records older than one day are rejected. Default request limit: 64 KiB.

route.description: Normalized path template, without query, fragment or personal identifiers.

metrics.description: Document/restored visits: LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB. SPA records: routeReady only.
